create_mcts_config: create an MctsConfig dataclass instance with exploration_scalar, beam_limit, max_rollout_depth, num_iterations, max_steps, and rollout_weight
create_search_context: create a SearchContext dataclass instance holding MCTS config, policy and critic stubs, environment, seed, and task name
run_mcts: run MCTS simulations on a MiniWob task using a SearchContext and return the sequence of visited nodes
build_mcts_node: build an MctsNode representing a state in the MCTS search tree with action sequence, value estimate, and child actions
test_mcts_node_select_action: test the MctsNode.select_action method that chooses the action maximizing the UCT score
